programme.title: Eating Inn
programme.desc: An episode of surprises. From Chef Nobu's Japanese/Peruvian fusion technique, to his long-time successful partnership with actor Robert De Niro, to his Exec Chef in Sydney, Filipino Harold Hurtada.

programme.title: Eating Inn
programme.desc: Chef Oscar Perez is a dear old friend of the Toque 12 series having starred in our very first episode of Toque 12 Indonesia some years ago. programme.title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses
programme.sub-title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses Series 2 Ep 7
programme.desc: Director Amy has a sparkling 7.25 million pound home in Surrey to sell, designed to appeal to the wealthy football set. Manager Guy helps the Irish owners of an exclusive chateau in France's Loire Valley find VIP clients with 30 grand a night to spare. Lee searches for a buyer for an 8.45 million pound Hampstead home on behalf of his childhood friend, and Diana helps the owner of a private jet company find a luxury central London pad.

programme.title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses
programme.sub-title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses Series 2 Ep 8
programme.desc: Managing Director Guy and sales broker John get a contemporary six million pound home on their books with a panoramic views of Cheshire's countryside. Jaishree helps a Swedish designer sell her minimalistic two bed Chelsea apartment for 2.6 million pounds. Amy closes the sale of a restored 17th century water mill. John searches for buyers for a Grade 2 listed Regency townhouse on Brighton's seafront, and Lee gets involved with a 10 million pound development in Hampstead.

Over the years, Elaine has taken in countless lost and unwanted chooks, giving them a home, teaching them tricks, and forming a unique bond with her feathered family.

programme.title: Grand Tours Of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul continues his journey down the mighty River Tay, from the white-water rapids of Grandtully through the fair city of Perth to the briny firth. Beneath an ancient oak near Dunkeld, Paul meets a man who plays the music of Niel Gow on a fiddle once owned by the composer himself.

programme.title: Grand Tours Of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: The River Irvine in Ayrshire is the hidden gem explored on this Grand Tour. From its source close to Loudoun Hill, Paul follows the river through ancient battle fields and discovers a legacy of lacemaking and a treasure trove of gemstones along its banks.

programme.title: Wogball: Australia's Beautiful Game
programme.desc: Presented by Aussie Hollywood star Anthony LaPaglia, Wogball tells the remarkable, emotional story of how football overcame racism, media hostility and fierce competition to become one of modern Australia's greatest success stories. Packed with surprising revelations, nostalgia and moments of pure joy, this is a passionate celebration of the beautiful game and the perfect warm-up to the 2026 World Cup.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Tour De France 2026 Full Stages

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: A zombie virus decimates all of Earth's population except the Mi'qmaq community of Red Crow.

programme.title: The Company
programme.desc: An inside look at ballet's highs and lows, following dancers balancing love and ambition. Neve Campbell stars as a rising ballerina, with Malcolm McDowell and James Franco in key roles.

programme.title: Bill And Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Two slacker airheads, who are about to fail their history class, are given the chance to take an epic trip through time in order to help them ace their final exam. Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter star in the most outrageous comedy in the history of history. With appearances by Napoleon, Beethoven, Socrates, Billy the Kid and Abraham Lincoln. Directed by Stephen Herek and also stars George Carlin. (From the US) (Comedy) (1989) (Rpt) PG

programme.title: Love And Friendship
programme.desc: Set in 18th century English society, the film focuses on the machinations of a beautiful widow, Lady Susan Vernon, who, while waiting for social chatter about a personal indiscretion to pass, takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate. While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: A Las Vegas mystery man (Robert Redford) offers a desperate couple (Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson) $1 million for a night with the wife.

programme.title: Escape From New York
programme.desc: In a dystopian 1997, Manhattan has been transformed in the new York Maximum Security Penitentiary, where criminals are sent in life sentences. Grabbing a bargaining chip right out of the air, convicts bring down the President's plane in bad old Gotham. Gruff Snake Plissken, a one-eyed lone warrior new to prison life, is coerced into bringing the President and his cargo out of this land of undesirables.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Megan Spencer, Jaimie Leonarder and Fenella Kernebone present reviews, interviews and an insider's view of the world of movies, while Marc Fennell reviews new-release DVDs.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Where The Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Max's bedroom undergoes a mysterious transformation into a jungle environment, and he winds up sailing to an island inhabited by monsters, simply called the Wild Things.

programme.title: A Walk In The Clouds
programme.desc: In this visually stunning film, a disillusioned WWII vet's (Keanu Reeves) life takes a surprising turn when he poses as the husband of the daughter of a domineering vineyard owner.

programme.title: Paris, 13th District
programme.desc: Set in the French capital’s 13th arrondissement, on the left bank of the Seine, Audiard’s film charts the interwoven relationships between four twenty-somethings.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
programme.sub-title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize Series 1 Ep 5

programme.desc: This week's competition is in South Wales, where first to host is farm girl Claire who's hoping to fill her guests' bellies with some local Welsh produce.

programme.desc: Talk about a deliciously difficult decision: Adam and his guests, ice cream expert Terri Mercieca and cookie CEO Brooke Bellamy must choose between cookies or cream.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Will travels to the beautiful Jamtland region in central of Sweden to learn about traditional cave ripened goats milk cheese, and an ancient way of preserving long milk. Here he discovers the world’s most expensive cheese made from moose milk, before heading into the mountains to visit the Myhrbodarna Dairy and chef Magnus Nilsson at Fäviken.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: Warren's next stop is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa's largest game reserves, where he's staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge. He heads out on safari and tastes a variety of native bush foods, including the Marula Tree fruit - used to make a liqueur called Amarula. Back at the lodge, Warren is inspired to cook up his favourite South African dessert, Malva pudding, served with Amarula custard.

programme.title: Flat Out Food

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: Si and Dave tackle dishes that you never dreamed you could make yourself. But they prove that homemade can beat shop-bought when they prepare gravalax, jam doughnuts, their own corned beef and even an Indian favourite, paneer.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke’s next stop is Hoi An, and while en-route, Luke cooks wok tossed beef in the train’s kitchen carriage. He soon realises the on-board cooks have an amazing ability of balance while the train moves from side to side on the railway tracks.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
